scripts.check: pnpm --filter @sprite-desktop/web check && pnpm --filter @sprite-desktop/provision check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sprite-desktop/web test && cargo test --workspace && python3 -m unittest discover -s installer -p 'test_*.py' && shellcheck installer/desktop.sh installer/install.sh && tsx --test scripts/build-release.test.ts
